How is option 1 incorrect, only the owner can read write, group can read and others have no permission set
I mean question does not say anything about the executable permissions

posts.name: Suthir Kunar
posts.cooked: Option1 provides executable permissions, whereas the questions only asks to set read and write to owner and read to group. In general, its implied additional permissions will not be set other than what is requested.

posts.name: premith
posts.cooked:
The question only implies only owner can read and write the group can read and others have no permission

The question does not ask only to set read and write but rather only the owner should be able to read and write, I think there is a difference in that

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If the owner needs to only read and write, we will only provide read and write permissions, not a superset of this. This is known as Least Privilege Principle and is already discussed in the second chapter.

Screenshot 2025-07-15 at 18.07.38980×766 69.7 KB

posts.name: premith
posts.cooked:
The question is a bit ambiguous in that. It’s not written that the owner needs to only, but it’s written that only the owner should be able to read and write.

But I never thought about the least privilege principle when I approached the problem. That makes lot of sense. I think that’s where I got it wrong
